executionScope: Seven targeted cases passed across two full-pack QA runs. The other registered full-pack cases were not rerun. All 34 isolated GameTests and 53 JUnit tests passed in the final build.

firstFailures.cause: The test incorrectly treated vanilla empty LORE as absence; corrected to compare additional output against the complete native default book plus its enchantment and repair cost. Production semantics unchanged.

The test assumed entry.owner() identified the supplying mod. Native bytecode and data show owner=rechiseled:datapacks and recipe=rechiseled_chipped:stone. Corrected both exact assertions; native membership and 1:1 conversion passed on rerun. No bridge content or balance changed.

behaviors.arcana: Native interaction separates three enchantments including a curse, spends exactly two ordinary books, preserves every level and source metadata once, preserves prior work on all outputs, changes no XP or campaign, rejects insufficient space/payment and invalid physical/player states, exact capacity succeeds and creative pays.
behaviors.settlement: Seven globally selected loaded recipes retain their inputs/results. Native placement and block use open shutters and both stacked gate pieces, two paid pieces break into exactly two real item drops, and a garden light switches 15 to 0.
behaviors.builder: Eight globally selected native recipes retain inputs/results. Loaded glass produces redstone15/light15 and allows entity collision passage; native lamps switch in both directions. The Chipped stone group retains explicit bridge provenance and native 1:1 conversion.

curation.glassential: Official 3.4.6 replaces the unbooted 3.4.5 reference candidate; final JAR dependency ranges unchanged.

limitations: No Computer Use or client launch. Final 178-dependency client rendering, HUD, models, key behavior and bilingual service hints are unverified.
Native recipe/group checks do not establish a real powered Mechanical Chisel workload, tape-measure interaction, complete GUI crafting flow or claimed-area permissions.
Glassential published gravity/multiplayer-paint/lit-pane fixes are not directly exercised here.
Idle snapshots do not establish performance acceptance; final-scale gameplay, 2-hour stability, moving routes and six external players remain pending.
Other four practical Ark services, natural first-hour survival, 150-200h pacing, final quest/mod scale, public release and weekly review acceptance remain open.
